messages:
sara: Heads up — we need a unified dashboard + oncall playbook for continuous-batching health. Focus: batch size distribution, p50/p95 queue wait, and a clear saturation indicator. Can runtime/infra owners drop canonical metric names and example queries? Need this for the rollout UX too.

omar: We already emit `batch.size_histogram` and `batch.wait_seconds` from the runtime. Labels: model, route, deployment. Will paste PromQL snippets in a bit. :+1:

jin: Infra emits `inference.queue_depth` (gauge) and `inference.queue_capacity` (gauge per zone). Also `worker.available_slots` which is useful for saturation. We should consider `kv_cache_hit_ratio` as a modifier — bad cache hit can make small batches more likely.

mike: For dashboards I'd propose panels: 1) Batch size heatmap (histogram by size bucket x route), 2) p50/p95 wait time by model_id and route, 3) Queue saturation ratio by zone, 4) Scatter or hexbin of latency vs batch size (to spot regressions).

sara: One nit — we have inconsistent label names. Runtime uses `model` while infra uses `model_id`. Can we standardize on `model_id`? Also prefer `route` not `route_id` for readability.

omar: Ack, we'll standardize to `model_id` and `route`. I'll change the exporter labels and keep `deployment` too. Draft PromQL for p95 wait by model: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batch.wait_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_id, route))` — example to wire into Grafana.

jin: PromQL draft for saturation (by zone):
```
sum(inference.queue_depth) by (zone) / sum(inference.queue_capacity) by (zone)
```
Trigger threshold we discussed = 0.7 (70%) for a P2 alert. For P1 set > 0.9 with sustained 3m.

lina: From product/rollouts: we need a canary signal — if the canary's avg batch wait > 2x baseline for 10m, auto-fallback. Can we attach that to the rollout controller? :eyes:

mike: Possible. Canary metric expression (rough): `avg_over_time(batch.wait_seconds_sum{deployment=~"canary.*"}[10m]) / avg_over_time(batch.request_count{deployment=~"baseline.*"}[10m])` — if > 2 then mark degrade. I'll refine into a more stable ratio using rates.

sara: Love it. Also add a visualization with shaded baseline band so PMs see drift. For oncall playbook: include quick checks — 1) is queue saturation high? 2) is batch size histogram shifting to smaller buckets? 3) KV cache miss spike? 4) any recent rollouts?

omar: I'll push label changes and the `batch.size_histogram` buckets to match Grafana buckets by EOD. I'll also add `batch.request_count` and `batch.wait_seconds_sum` (counters) so averages are easier to compute.

jin: I'll expose `inference.queue_capacity` per zone and confirm cardinality is low (<10 zones). Will add a `queue_saturation` derived metric in the infra metrics pipeline so dashboards don't compute heavy joins.

mike: I'll create a Grafana folder "batching-health" with the panels above, plus an alert rule group: batch-wait-regression (canary vs baseline), queue-saturation, and batch-size-skew (detect shift in histogram percentiles). I'll post links when ready.

sara: Action items recap: Omar = update runtime metrics + labels; Jin = expose capacity & derived saturation; Mike = draft dashboards + alerts; Lina = finalize canary thresholds; Oncall-Alex = sanity-check alerts with synthetic load tomorrow AM. Everyone add example queries to the drive doc. :memo:

oncall-alex: Copy, I'll run a synthetic canary and post results in this thread tomorrow morning.

telemetry-bot: Grafana folder created: /dashboards/batching-health (draft).

sara: Great — thanks all. We'll aim to have alerts + playbook ready before the next deploy cutoff. :rocket:
